title: Vanishing of the character sum at a nonzero point
statement:
Fix $n\in\bbn$ and a point $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, and for each subset $S\subseteq[n]$ let $\chi_S(x)=\prod_{i\in S}(-1)^{x_i}$ be the Walsh–Fourier character. If $x$ is not the all-zeros point, then
\[
  \sum_{S\subseteq[n]}\chi_S(x)=0,
\]
the sum ranging over all $2^n$ subsets of $[n]$.
hypotheses_covered: x is a point of the Boolean hypercube {0,1}^n
x is not the all-zeros point (x ≠ zero_vec n)
